name: Seikimatsu Gakuen Densetsu Ouka 2 ~Zettai Seigi no Wana!~
original_name: 世紀末学園伝説オウカ2 ～絶対性技の罠!～
source:
At an elite boarding school, female students are abducted one by one.
When special teenage investigator Ouca Kamikaze learns her older brother Ginga has abused a power called the Way of the Unconditional Technique, she transfers into the school...
